description: pixel art landscape, the island of buyan in the middle of the sea: a gigantic green oak, the world tree, rising from a rocky island up into the clouds, a white stone glowing at its foot, waves around the island and old shipwrecks on the shore, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, very dark muted palette of sea teal, deep green and foam white, no text, no border, no people in front, no animals in front
